nom: Murad Clarifying Gel Cleanser with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers (t-zone, eyelids, whole face) describe the cleanser as helpful for controlling excess oil, with some saying it dries their skin less than others report because their skin is naturally oily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with normally dry skin report the product can leave cheeks, jaw, and the corners of the mouth scaly, tight, or dried out, though a few say daily moisturizing keeps it comfortable.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (oily t-zone, drier elsewhere) mostly report clearer skin and reduced breakouts, but some note dryness or irritation concentrated in the drier areas of the face.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several describe burns, itching, redness, or rash-like reactions after just one or two uses, while a few others (including one with Lupus-related skin sensitivity) report no burning or irritation and real improvement.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 30s/40s describes it as helpful for hormonal and adult acne alongside a hydrating serum and moisturizer, giving a smoother, brighter result.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports more youthful-looking skin alongside reduced acne after a month of use; no other aging-specific claims appear.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the cleanser as drying, tight, or requiring immediate moisturizer to avoid dry patches or a scaly texture; a smaller group says it does not dry them out at all, especially those with oilier skin.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report redness decreasing alongside their acne, while others describe new redness, burning, or a rash-like reaction, particularly on sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe a burnt, chemical-burn, or scaly 'crocodile skin' sensation after only one to three uses, pointing to barrier irritation; others report no such reaction over months of use.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention breakouts or pimples report the cleanser reduced or cleared them, including cystic and hormonal acne, but a notable minority say it caused new white bumps or worsened their breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers frequently credit the cleanser with clearing blackheads, whiteheads, and small bumps over weeks of use, though a few say it produced new bumps or textured 'sandpaper' skin instead.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers generally report the product keeps oil under control and leaves skin feeling clean, with one exception noting increased oiliness alongside new white bumps.

aspects.libelle: Strong tea tree or tequila-like smell

extraits.texte: Received this as a sample product and was excited to use something that might clear my skin allll the way. I've always had some blackheads on my nose and use masks every other day to clear them. First 2 days were great using the product. Has a minty menthol smell and feel too it. Woke up on day 3 and my face is completely broken out. I now have multiple spots of painful cystic acne, mini bumps over the entire face, some of those bumps have white heads, and caused a very burny flakey painful rash. I have combo sensitive skin and would 1000% NOT recommend this to anyone. On day 3 and 4 I did not use the product but it is now getting worse. This has completely ruined my face. Had to make an emergency appointment to my dermatologist. I'm so disappointed in this product that I have nothing nice to say about it.

I have stubborn acne but I also have combination skin, so some areas are dry and sensitive. Those dry and sensitive areas became very irritated and very dry after using this twice daily. Im talking chemical burn. However, it did clear my acne by about 70%-80% (best results I have seen from any product on my skin). When I reduced using this to once a day and used different cleanser for my 2nd wash, it did not cause irritation. I recommend this for people who have closer to oily skin, or skin that is more resilient. On the other hand I definitely suggest to AVOID this product if you do have sensitive or dry areas.

I normally have dry skin so I don't have many breakouts except an occasional one from hormones once a month. Since COVID we have to wear masks at work everyday and it's caused lots of breakouts and acne near the chin and jaw area. Tried this and it cleared the acne BUT I put this all over my face Two days in a row and I now have a scaly texture all over my cheeks, jaw, and chin. It feels and looks scaly not peeling just textured. Exfoliation and moisturizer has not changed the scaly texture. Not sure what happened. Not using this product again... maybe not for my skin type. Feel like I have crocodile skin.

At first I got this product as a sample size and it worked wonders for my hormonal acne I had when I was really stressed doing my nursing rotations. I have extremely oily skin (eyelids and t-zone) and it was help tremendously with controlling that and leaving my skin feeling clean! Yes it is drying but you're supposed to moisturize after it even says on the bottle "step 1" I got the largest size and yes it is a lil pricey but you get over 13 oz of cleanser and it's a lot and I like the pump bc although it doesn't squeeze a lot of product out, it gives the quantity need without being wasteful!! I will definitely purchase this again !!!!

I have very sensitive skin, I have Lupus and my malar rash gets very easily irritated. With wearing a mask all day I really have terrible maskne and this has worked so well for me. I don't have any dry patches, no burning or red spots anywhere and the outbreaks have definitely gone down.

extraits.titre: Wow this is amazing for acne
extraits.texte: I am shocked by this product! I have had bad acne on my forehead and chin for atleast the past week or two and tend to get it on my forehead regularly. I finally broke down and bought this cleanser because murad has worked well for me in the past. Literally after one wash with this my skin improved overnight! The acne is less red and some has gone away. I was nervous to try this product because I have sensitive, combination skin and most acne products dry my skin out really bad. I plan to only use once a day to see if that happens but this face wash has already helped! Also, my skin did not feel irritated after this which I was glad about!

Shrank the size of the bottle from 6.7oz to 5 and kept the price the same. Changed the formula and now doesnt lather like it used to or clean my face well anymore. I find myself using more product to attempt to feel clean. 2 months in and I still have brow and forehead breakouts that i havent had since high school. Really sucks. I used to love this product something fierce.
